frames.name: 运行中
frames.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, production-quality desktop app UI at 1440 x 1024, app content only. This is a revised interaction storyboard for ONE Paseo plugin, not alternative themes or different products. The three frames use the SAME design system, shell, synthetic task, information architecture and fixed light neutral palette. Date anchor: 2026-10-20; omit dates unless useful.
Use the attached PUBLIC Paseo homepage screenshot strictly as product grounding: its LOWER embedded desktop product demonstrates the existing sidebar, workspace tabs, native tool surfaces and restrained app UI. Do not reproduce the marketing webpage, large hero headline, download controls, browser chrome, wallpaper or presentation frame. Preserve native Paseo shell topology. This is an extension of an existing product, not a new standalone app.
Public API implementation boundary: the LEFT native app sidebar and top native screen header remain host-owned. Add only one plugin sidebar item named 工作概览. The plugin owns the CONTENT of an addScreen master-detail view. It can read real host/workspace/agent state, show actual permission actions, and navigate with openAgent/openWorkspace. NO fake composer, no fake pause/steer/stop, no replacing native project tree or agent pane, no pretend native diff deep link. No architecture diagrams, implementation labels, API names or compatibility explanations inside the user flow.
Visual system: near-white #ffffff main canvas, very pale gray #f7f7f8 sidebar, foreground #202124, muted #74777e, separator #e7e8eb, selected row #eff2f7, restrained action blue #3564a9. Amber/green are small semantic markers only. System sans with excellent Chinese typography, body 14–16px, hierarchy 24/18/15/13px. Mono only for paths/commands. Consistent 8px spacing rhythm. Use spacing, grouping, alignment and type first, simple separators second. Avoid nested cards, border around every row, pill/badge proliferation, dashboards, KPI tiles, charts, shadows, gradients, glow, giant empty hero space. Flat calm native-feeling productivity UI, crisp readable Chinese text, absolutely no clipping.
LOCKED layout in every frame: 216px native app sidebar at left; slim 52px native header across remaining width; plugin content below with a 312px session-list column and a spacious right detail area. Sidebar: Paseo wordmark; native 新建工作区, 历史记录, 计划任务; plugin 工作概览 highlighted; native 工作区 section with reconnect selected, documentation underneath; bottom native 设置. Do not add nine technical navigation levels.
Native header: 工作概览 at left; small host picker Devbox · 在线 at right. Plugin session column heading 当前工作区; compact scope paseo-plugins / reconnect and branch feature/reconnect. Three ordinary list rows separated by whitespace/fine dividers, never individual cards: selected 修复断线后的会话恢复; below 更新使用说明 with 空闲; below 检查错误处理 with 等待输入. Each row has a small state indicator and concise latest activity. A quiet link at bottom 其他机器 · 本机未连接, where offline means unknown, not zero running work.
Detail header: breadcrumb paseo-plugins / reconnect; title 修复断线后的会话恢复; small provenance Devbox · Codex · GPT-6.1-Sol. These are synthetic fixture labels, not product recommendations. Full detail preserves a comfortable text reading width and substantial whitespace. Small footer 设计示意 · 合成数据. Show ONE primary action relevant to the current state and only one or two supporting links. Everything visible serves the current user decision.

FRAME STATE: observe active work. The selected session row has a small blue dot and 运行中. In the detail view show a concise status line 运行中 · 正在验证重连行为. Under 当前进展 show the exact latest agent statement: 已完成会话保留逻辑，正在检查断线与恢复路径。 This is a real-looking quoted source excerpt, not an invented predictive progress estimate. Then a compact expandable activity section with three ordinary rows: 已修改 3 个文件; 正在执行 npm run test:reconnect; 查看活动记录 with a chevron. Keep completed and currently running activities distinguishable with small icons and text. Small context line 当前工作区变更 · +42 −16, explicitly workspace-scoped, not attributed exclusively to this session. At the bottom of the detail section primary button 打开会话 to use native conversation controls; secondary text 查看工作区. NO composer in this plugin screen, NO percentage progress, NO task-complete badge. The hero experience is scanning current progress without reading all tool logs, while retaining a clear path to the native session. One coherent app frame only, no storyboard grid or split before/after.
